What's New in v4.5.0 - Local Media Gallery: Scans downloaded media across Mori directories with categorized tabs (Video, Audio, Image, PDF), live counters, and persistent sorting (Newest, Oldest, A-Z, Size) - In-App Native PDF Viewer: Bundled offline PDF.js engine with high-DPI canvas rendering, viewport lazy rendering, page 1 cover generator, and page count subtitle - High-Resolution 640px Thumbnails: Upgraded Android native frame extraction, web canvas generator, and PDF covers to 640px JPEG with sequential queue processing - Audio Gallery Previews & Grid Covers: History-style audio playback in gallery viewer with album art, track details, local binary streaming, and album artwork on grid cards - Gallery Favorites Priority: Favorited items float to top of grid with heart badge, accent card border, and real-time cross-tab synchronization - In-App File Deletion: Cross-platform file deletion via trash button, card long-press haptic, or viewer modal with Android MediaScanner purge and Tauri backend support - Player Volume Toggle & Unmute Badge: Dedicated volume button in player bar, floating frosted-glass "Tap to unmute" badge for WebKit/macOS autoplay restrictions, and decoupled fullscreen toggle - Desktop Tauri Backend Commands: Implemented native Rust commands for recursive directory scanning (tauri_list_dir) and filesystem deletion (tauri_delete_file) - Instant Auto-Paste & Native Paste: Reduced clipboard check delay to 300ms on start/resume, with native paste event listener on input for instant link analysis - Privacy Lock Protection: Integrated Gallery with Mori PIN and biometric authentication with auto-lock on app pause/minimize - Gallery DOM Card Reuse: Map-based card caching preserves DOM nodes during filter and sort switches, eliminating decoder lag and image flicker - Scan Concurrency & Duplicate Fixes: Replaced boolean lock with active promise deduplication and resolved Android directory namespace prefixes to prevent duplicate media cards - Video Aspect Ratio & Local Loop Fixes: Enforced contain fit for 9:16 portrait videos in viewer and synchronized HTML loop attributes with ended fallback - Settings Audit & Cleanup: Purged orphaned auto-clear toggles in favor of day-based retention select menus, preventing accidental launch cache wipes

What's New in v4.4.0 - Custom Fullscreen Video Player: Replaced native WebView fullscreen with a custom cross-platform player featuring a title header, 60fps seek scrubbing, mute toggle, and back-button / Esc navigation - Batch Photo Download & PDF Export: Concurrently download all photos in carousels/slides (Instagram, TikTok, Pixiv, Douyin, RedNote) or compile them into a single PDF document - Reddit & TeraBox Platform Support: Added 2 new platforms (16 total) supporting RapidSave Reddit media and Sechno TeraBox folder and file extraction - Floating Download Bubble: Persistent monochrome floating bubble tracking up to 5 concurrent downloads with live progress rings - Concurrent Download Pool: Full concurrent download pool (up to 5 for photos/files, up to 3 for audio/video playlists) with safe rate-limit pacing - Scraper Engine Architecture: Removed binary obfuscation/encryption layer in favor of plain bundled JavaScript (bundle.js) with deterministic OTA hot-patching - Spotify Engine Provider: Migrated Server 2 (SoundLoaders) to the active spotimate.app backend with multipart token authentication - Threads Downloader: Resolved payload serialization mismatch on Android native bridges and preserved direct CDN streaming to prevent Instagram 403 Forbidden errors - YTMP3 Downloader: Separated format conversions into sequential calls with cache-busting and handled dynamic redirect loops - Bandcamp Downloader: Migrated to dynamic /get/token API and standard multipart form submissions - Multi-Photo Overwrite Collision: Appended slide index (_${photoIdx}) to filenames and unique temp file names (.tmp) to prevent file overwrite collisions during 1-by-1 downloads - History Multi-Photo Previews: Fixed duplicate slide preview in History modal where Image 1 was mistakenly repeated across all slide previews - History Card Thumbnails: Fixed broken thumbnail icons on History cards for downloaded multi-photo sets via Capacitor URI mapping - Offline History Playback: Enforced strictly offline media playback, suppressing remote network fallback and remote poster requests when viewing downloaded items - False Missing File Status: Guarded showMissingStatus() in result modals to prevent false missing warnings on un-downloaded items - Nested Directory Prefix: Resolved duplicate directory prefixes (Download/Download/Mori -> Download/Mori) in PDF export and temp file cleanup

Since v1.1.0: the share-sheet import works from a cold start, and a pairing broadcast that never started is reported instead of hidden. ### What's fixed - **"Open in AirliftSilence" from the share sheet did nothing** (reported in #5). SwiftUI's `onOpenURL` never receives a document that another app opens while this app is cold-starting — the normal case for a sideloaded app that is not already running — so the request went nowhere. Document opens now arrive through `UIApplicationDelegate.application(_:open:options:)`, which does fire on a cold launch; `onOpenURL` keeps handling `airliftsilence://` URLs. Pairing files whose extension has no declared UTI (`.mobiledevicepairing`, `.mobilepairing`) are offered by the share sheet too, and a URL delivered twice is only imported once. - **A denied Local Network permission looked like a working app.** `NetService.publish()` fails silently without it, and Settings then never offers the **Pair with App** entry while the app kept saying "Advertising…". The status now reports what actually happened, error code included, and points at the permission. ### Install `AirliftSilence-v1.1.1.ipa` is **unsigned** — sign it with whatever you normally use (AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore, …). Re-signing gives the app a fresh container, so export the pairing file first if you have a working one. Requires **iOS 18.0 – 27.2 beta 2**. Apple patched the underlying exploit in 27.2 beta 3. Also needs **LocalDevVPN** in loopback mode (never `127.0.0.1`), a **pairing record**, and the official **Apple Books** app opened at least once. ``` AirliftSilence-v1.1.1.ipa 3,348,064 bytes sha256 daa32fe3cbf4673178abbc9f297ceb1d25e463c2bb644eee5ad1679b7301ce4e ```

## Shortcuts and Siri The app now ships App Intents, so it appears in the Shortcuts app as actions of its own: | Shortcut action | Notes | |---|---| | *Call-recording announcement* | one step with an **Action** menu: Check / Silence / Restore | | *Silence the call-recording announcements* | no parameters — the one to put on the Home Screen | | *Restore the call-recording announcements* | no parameters | Each action returns the outcome as text (`Call-recording announcements: Silenced`, …), so a Shortcut can branch on it or show it in a notification. Siri phrases are registered in both languages, e.g. *"AirliftSilence 去掉通话录音提示音"*. The intents open the app when they run. That is deliberate: a run is a long device-side session, and an iOS background intent is cut off after a few seconds, which would tear the tunnel down mid-transfer. There is also a URL scheme, for anything that can only open a URL (an *Open URLs* action, a launcher, a bookmark): ``` airliftsilence://check airliftsilence://silence airliftsilence://restore ``` ## Languages English is now the development language, with a Simplified Chinese translation. The interface, the pairing status lines, the run log and the Local Network permission prompt all follow the system language. Adding another language means copying `en.lproj`, translating the values and re-running `xcodegen generate` — see [Languages](https://github.com/YiHoooong/AirliftSilence-iOS#languages). ## Also in this release - **`StartDisclosure.caf` is covered too.** All three announcements iOS plays during call recording are replaced now, not just two. `Greeting.caf` and `GreetingWithTone.m4a` sit in the same folder and are still deliberately left alone — those are voicemail greetings. - **Runs are serialised.** A Shortcut that arrives while the app is still checking waits its turn; the device only tolerates one exploit session at a time. - A check reads three files instead of two, so the check after launch takes a little longer. Unchanged: the periodic reminder twinkle (`recurringDisclosureTwinkle.caf`) lives on the sealed system volume and cannot be replaced by this exploit. ## Install Unsigned on purpose — re-sign with AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, … iOS 18.0 – 27.2 beta 2 only (Apple patched the exploit in 27.2 beta 3). The official Apple Books app has to be installed and opened once, and LocalDevVPN has to be running in loopback mode. ``` AirliftSilence-v1.1.0.ipa 3,340,425 bytes sha256 b5b658cfc00b70b61e8727cc09112517fec06ef34e0320fd031fb2886e9b44b5 ```

versions.localizedDescription: - **Engine sound no longer fades.** The game's sound engine dropped the engine, turbo and skid sounds when its mixing thread was held up for a moment, and they only came back at the next gear change. That no longer happens. Fix ported from SpeedBreaker (SpeedBreakerProject/speedbreaker). - **Steadier 60 fps.** The thread that keeps the game's 60 Hz timing now runs at real-time priority, so it wakes on time; frame timing on 120 Hz screens turns itself off if the screen does not keep to it. From SpeedBreaker. - **Accurate exposure Off is respected.** Turning it off in the launcher was undone at startup (GitHub issue #5); settings you choose are now kept even when they match the default. - **iOS 18, experimental.** The app now installs on iOS / iPadOS 18 (it needed 26). Nobody has tested it on iOS 18 yet: reports welcome.

- **Import PC saves.** The save manager's Import also takes a save from the PC game (v1.3, the file inside the profile's folder, or a .zip of it): it is converted to the Xbox 360 layout. Needs one career of this game on the device already (its options are reused). - **Motion blur switch.** Motion blur can be turned off in the launcher and in the in-game options; off, the picture stays sharp when driving fast. - **Save sync between devices fixed.** Part of a Black Edition career was kept in a separate file the save manager ignored, so a newer save (for example one more challenge event) did not show as newer on the other device, and could arrive incomplete. That file now travels with the save everywhere, and saves are copied to your iCloud Drive folder shortly after the game saves, not only when the launcher opens. - **Delete saves from iCloud.** A save that is only in iCloud can now be deleted from the save manager (tap it), instead of only downloaded. - **Simpler save manager.** One list of careers. Each shows its cash, bounty and when and on which device it was last saved, including careers only in iCloud. When another device has a newer save, the career says so and tapping it offers "Use the save from iPad" first. Sync now is the button at the top right. - **Import saves from the internet.** The save manager's Import button takes an Xbox 360 save file, a Xenia save folder or .zip, a .zip exported from the app, or the bare save file. - **Achievements follow you between devices.** With an iCloud Drive folder chosen, an achievement unlocked on one device now shows as unlocked on the others too. - **Black Edition content now actually turns on.** The switch set the wrong byte of the game's memory, so the content stayed hidden. Now the 70th Challenge Series event (the Camaro) and the Black Edition cars in Quick Race appear, and starting a career works. It is always on now: the launcher no longer has a switch for it. - **Smoother frame pacing with the FPS counter on.** Each counter update delayed a frame, a small stutter up to twice a second; the counter is now drawn into the game's picture (a square dark box). At the 60 fps cap frames are also made in step with the screen's refresh, as at 30 and 40. - **120 Hz simulation switch.** The game can move its world 120 times a second instead of 60 (Advanced tab, off by default; always on with the 120 fps cap). - **Options while playing.** In a menu or the pause screen, tap the gear at the top right (or press L3+R3 on a controller) to change the render resolution, MetalFX, the 30/60 fps cap, anti-aliasing and the battery settings without restarting. Settings that need a restart (40/120 fps, MSAA) are marked "next launch". - **HUD size and position.** New HUD settings (launcher Graphics tab and the options while playing): the race HUD's size and safe zone (how close to the screen's edges it sits), and the minimap, the speedometer and the race info (standings, laps, times) moved left, right, up or down on their own. - **Post-processing switch fixed.** Turning it off now really removes the colour filter, bloom and vignette; it can also be changed while playing. - **Battery mode now caps the game at 30 fps**, along with its other savings. - **New setting: reflection and mirror resolution.** The reflections on the cars and the rear-view mirror are drawn at the Xbox 360's size (the default, lighter) or follow the render resolution (a sharper mirror). - **About a quarter less battery drain while playing**, with the same picture, resolution and frame rate: the game's threads ask iOS for a lower priority, so the CPU runs at cheaper speeds (measured on an iPad Pro M4 at 1.5x / 60 fps). On by default on devices with at least 6 efficiency cores (M-series iPads); off on iPhones, where it made the game stutter. Override with `--ios_utility_qos=true|false --ios_utility_qos_guest=true|false`. - **Smoother police pursuits on iPhones.** Pursuits dropped to about 22 fps because some game threads stayed on t

# Air 5.1.0 > [!NOTE] > 本次更新主要为 **Minecraft 26.3** 做了适配,并修复了 **JIT 启动闪退**等问题; > 若您在启动游戏时遇到闪退、黑屏、直接崩溃等问题，请更新至该版本。 > 同时新增 **AI 助手**、启动时自动检查更新等功能。26.2 与 26.3 都可以正常使用,请悉知. ## 更新内容 * 新增 **AI 助手**:可以和你对话,也能帮你找资源、装模组/整合包/光影,还能读取游戏日志、分析崩溃原因 @herbrine8403 * 新增 **启动时自动检查更新**:有新版本会自动提示,并显示可滚动的更新说明 @yitenchen123 * 适配 **Minecraft 26.3**(SDL3 窗口/输入/呈现层):修复进入游戏黑屏、画面缩在角落、小窗显示错位、Vulkan 下帧率一直显示为 0、物品栏点不动、快捷栏按键错位等问题 @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403 * 修复 **MobileGlues 渲染器在 26.3 下闪退**的深层原因 @yiyeshi0-hash * 支持 **Metal(metallum)渲染器**,可用于 Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash * 新增 **MobileGL / MobileGL-gles** 渲染器,并新增 **SimpleFPEWrapper(sfpew)** 以支持 **1.17 及以下**版本(请在设置中开启 sfpew,并在渲染器中选择 **MobileGL-gles**);同时修复 MobileGlues 在 26.3 下的闪退与黑屏 @yitenchen123 * MobileGlues 内置源码升级到上游 2.0.x,着色器转换链不再互相干扰 @yitenchen123 * 引入 **LWJGL 3.3.3 / 3.4.1 两套运行库**看，可按游戏版本自动选择或手动选择 @yitenchen123 @herbrine8403 * 修复 **Forge / NeoForge 直装**时的启动器被关闭、直装后闪退、模块冲突等问题 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123 * 修复 OptiFine 直装、整合包导入,以及下载源和镜像相关的报错 @yitenchen123 * 修复 **JIT** 相关问题:开启 JIT 后启动不再闪退(含使用外部 JIT 后启动闪退的情况),并新增 JIT 工具选择 @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash * 优化**内存占用**:自动识别大内存权限,减少后台内存回收导致的闪退 @herbrine8403 @yitenchen123 * 补全简体中文缺失的文本,并同步 Crowdin @herbrine8403 * 改进**构建与打包流程**:双版本运行库、复用已编译组件、构建日志更清晰 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123 * 其他内容请前往 Commit 界面查看 ## 注意事项 > [!IMPORTANT] > 若要在 Minecraft 26.3 上使用 **Vulkan**,请把渲染器选为 **Zink**,同时把渲染 API 改为 **Vulkan**。 ## 贡献者 * @yitenchen123 * @herbrine8403 * @yiyeshi0-hash * @Gsjsjzhznsz **完整更新日志**: https://github.com/herbrine8403/Amethyst-iOS-MyRemastered/compare/5.0.0...5.1.0 --- # Air 5.1.0 > [!NOTE] > This update is mainly about **Minecraft 26.3** support and fixes several issues including **JIT startup crashes**; > it also adds an **AI assistant** and an automatic update check on launch. # Prisma 6.5.0 正式版 —— 包名迁移终点站 + e4mc 闪退根修 + 下载体验全面升级 6.0.0 以来累计 **190+ 次提交**（Task 249-259 十一轮迭代），聚焦装机反馈根治、联机链路重塑、渲染稳定性与下载体验。本版同时完成包名迁移终点站：`com.air-devs.air` → **`com.prisma-devs.prisma`**。 ## ⚠️ 包名迁移（重要，请先读） iOS 应用的数据容器按包名隔离——升级到本版后，新 App（`com.prisma-devs.prisma`）**不会**自动继承旧 App（`com.air-devs.air`）的数据（实例/存档/账户/设置）： 1. **旧 App 导出**：在旧版（air 包名）里使用 数据导出（设置 > 数据传输，可选只导出存档/模组/账户等分区） 2. **新 App 导入**：安装本版后使用 数据导入 选择备份 zip，重启生效 3. 迁移完成后可删除旧图标 4. **随本版一同发布的 `com.air-devs.air-legacy-EXPORT-ONLY.ipa` 仅供无法直接升级的用户导出数据使用，今后不再发布此包名**（这就是"上一次 CI 的 air 旧包名"最后一版，功能与 6.5.0 一致，仅包名不同） ## ✨ 6.0 → 6.5.0 重点更新 **渲染与画面** - **伪液态玻璃引擎换血**：Telegram LegacyGlassView 配方 1:1 移植——实况 backdrop 采样 + 玻璃矩阵调色 + SDF 边缘折射，玻璃档面板/弹窗/游戏内菜单全面升级；最低档改为全透明（毛玻璃最低档整层不装）；降低透明度自动回退原生 - **FSR 联动同源门**：1.8.9 等旧版本自动渲染器走 kw 链时不再误入 FSR 半分辨率缩窗（会话级渲染器单一事实源） - **主页新增"下载中心"磁贴**：安装进度页最小化/关闭后的重新打开入口（右面板入口并存） - **国内下载提速**：镜像测速探针从"纯延迟"升级为"延迟+吞吐量"双维度（Range GET 128KB 实测持续速率），根治"官方源延迟低但吞吐被国际出口摝死"的误选；探针日志同时输出两侧 RTT 与 KB/s，慢在哪一眼可见 **启动器功能** - **JVM 预设四档**（省内存 G1 / 正常 / 性能优先 / 自定义），版本设置页内可直接切换（实例级） - 控件自动检查更新开关、清理垃圾中心 + 主页磁贴、公告收敛（43→6 高信噪比）、右 Shift 会话重置 - AI 助手（提供商配置 / 会话列表 / 系统提示词） ## 🔧 崩溃根治（gamelog 取证驱动） - **26.3 FO 整合包启动崩溃**（iris MixinGpuTexture3 "loaded too early"）：MetallumAgent 对 KnotClassLoader 的 eager defineClass 门控延迟到 Main 类加载后 - **26.3 FO 整合包开局到局域网闪退**（SIGBUS @ libnetty_quiche JNI_OnLoad+0x0）：e4mc 运行时解包的 quic 原生库无签名被内核击杀——经 e4mc 自带的打包者接口优雅降级（e4mc 公网中继在 iOS 不可用，原版局域网/内置联机不受影响） - 26.3 退游闪退（gl_terminate 空安全）+ 退出挂后台（shutdown 看门狗双保险） - **右 Shift 第 8 次复发·结构性根修**：新实例/隔离新档/迁移新建实例的潜行键位此前默认左 Shift，与布局右 SHIFT 按钮错位成"死键"——启动前自动改绑（一次性，尊重后续手改）+ 会话起始输入状态确定性清账；**潜行按钮轻点后现在像"持续奔跑"一样有高亮，锁存状态一眼可见**。 - **切小窗再放大输入错位·自适应恢复**：iPadOS 26 自由窗口缩放后，窗口尺寸变化 0.3s 内自动完成几何全链重算与重宣告，不再需要重进会话。 - **启动器设置 → 通用**新增「导入旧版启动器数据（air 构建）」常驻入口（与欢迎向导同款一键迁移，随时可用）。 - **版本设置点启动立即跳回主页**，JIT 等待全程在主页语境下进行，不再有设置页"卡死"观感。 - **大型整合包（GLFW 时代 / 1.21.x 等）启动自诊断增强**：静默退出自动留存日志快照（latestlog.selfexit-*.txt，保留 3 份）、GLFW 桥窗口创建期探针、启动看门狗窗口期 8 秒快照落栈——再次遇到"无输出"上传日志即可一轮定位。 - (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked) - Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date. - Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches. ## Multiple LiveContainers - Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367) ## Share to Apps in LiveContainer Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357) ## Multitasking - Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208) - Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250) - Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling. - URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows. ## JIT - Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler. ## TweakLoader You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN # Improvements - Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194) - IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded. - Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support. - Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress. - Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions. - Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388) - Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417) # Bug Fixes - Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339) - Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209) - Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239) - Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368) - Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347) - Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386) - Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430) - Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329) - Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870) - Added support for iOS 27 developer beta.

# LiveContainer 3.7.0 > [!Warning] > The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation. > We recommend installing LiveContainer + SideStore using [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. Happy Spring Festival / Lunar New Year! After six months of development, we’re excited to release **LiveContainer 3.7.0**. This update introduces several powerful new features, including the Launch App Shortcut, iOS 26 JIT script support, external containers, native icon generation, and more. # New Features ## Launch App Shortcut > [!Note] > This feature requires LiveContainer to be installed with at least the **LaunchAppExtension** and **LaunchAppExtensionHelper** extension. iOS 16+ is supported. A new extension allows apps to launch instantly without opening the LiveContainer main interface (for apps that are not locked, hidden, or JIT-required). Once configured, the shortcut prepares the runtime environment and selects an available LiveContainer instance to launch the app directly. This reduces extra relaunches and jumps and typically saves 1~2 seconds per launch. See the [setup guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/guides/add-to-home-screen) for instructions. ## JIT Support for iOS 26 JIT scripts has been added by @Vishram1123. Scripts can be configured in app-specific settings and loaded automatically on iOS 26+. The **“StikDebug in another LiveContainer”** option has been fixed, allowing StikDebug to run within LiveContainer. When launching a JIT-required app, LiveContainer will automatically detect StikDebug, launch it in an available container, and pass all required parameters — including scripts — to enable JIT. In addition, when enabling JIT for multitasked app, LiveContainer will prioritize launching StikDebug as a multitask app to save app slot usage. (TODO: this doesn’t automatically minimize StikDebug after enabling JIT, might be added later) Be sure to convert StikDebug into a shared app before use. ## External Containers > [!Note] > Containers stored on external media (portable drives, SMB shares, etc.) are unsupported by many apps and may cause instability or crashes. You can now use external folders as app containers. This is useful if you want to manage app data through a file manager while still accessing it in LiveContainer, or if you want maintain container access when an app is shared. To configure this, open: **App-Specific Settings → Select External Data Folder** ## Native Icons LiveContainer now generates icons using native iOS libraries. On iOS 18+, this enables proper Light, Dark, and Original (Liquid Glass) icon rendering. These icons can also be saved for home screen shortcuts. ## Multitasking Improvements * Added **“Skip app terminate screen”** (by @boa-z) * Added **”Single Window Mode”** to minimize other apps when a maximized app is brought to front * Launch URL schemes can now be passed to multitasking apps. Passing URL between multitask apps can be controlled via **”Redirect URL to Host”** switch * Launching Private Apps is now possible. By default, apps launched with private container is only given sandbox access to its own data container folder. You can change it in developer settings. * Changed animations a little bit ## AltStore Source Support Basic AltSource support has been implemented by @StephenDev0. Sources can be added using: ``` livecontainer://sources?url=<URL> ``` ## Other Additions * App remarks are now supported (by @WingCH) * Decrypted apps can now be installed via `itms-services` links (by @WingCH) # Bug Fixes * Fixed iOS 26.4b1 compatibility (#1152) * Fixed crashes caused by `-[NSUserDefaults synchronize]` returning NO * Fixed signing crashes when apps contain too many libraries (#1135) * Fixed signing failure when not enough space is available to insert HM_DYLIB in Mach-O headers

# LiveContainer 3.7.0 > [!Warning] > The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation. > We recommend installing LiveContainer + SideStore using [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details. Happy Spring Festival / Lunar New Year! After six months of development, we’re excited to release **LiveContainer 3.7.0**. This update introduces several powerful new features, including the Launch App Shortcut, iOS 26 JIT script support, external containers, native icon generation, and more. # New Features ## Launch App Shortcut > [!Note] > This feature requires LiveContainer to be installed with at least the **LaunchAppExtension** and **LaunchAppExtensionHelper** extension. iOS 16+ is supported. A new extension allows apps to launch instantly without opening the LiveContainer main interface (for apps that are not locked, hidden, or JIT-required). Once configured, the shortcut prepares the runtime environment and selects an available LiveContainer instance to launch the app directly. This reduces extra relaunches and jumps and typically saves 1~2 seconds per launch. See the [setup guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/guides/add-to-home-screen) for instructions. ## JIT Support for iOS 26 JIT scripts has been added by @Vishram1123. Scripts can be configured in app-specific settings and loaded automatically on iOS 26+. The **“StikDebug in another LiveContainer”** option has been fixed, allowing StikDebug to run within LiveContainer. When launching a JIT-required app, LiveContainer will automatically detect StikDebug, launch it in an available container, and pass all required parameters — including scripts — to enable JIT. In addition, when enabling JIT for multitasked app, LiveContainer will prioritize launching StikDebug as a multitask app to save app slot usage. (TODO: this doesn’t automatically minimize StikDebug after enabling JIT, might be added later) Be sure to convert StikDebug into a shared app before use. ## External Containers > [!Note] > Containers stored on external media (portable drives, SMB shares, etc.) are unsupported by many apps and may cause instability or crashes. You can now use external folders as app containers. This is useful if you want to manage app data through a file manager while still accessing it in LiveContainer, or if you want maintain container access when an app is shared. To configure this, open: **App-Specific Settings → Select External Data Folder** ## Native Icons LiveContainer now generates icons using native iOS libraries. On iOS 18+, this enables proper Light, Dark, and Original (Liquid Glass) icon rendering. These icons can also be saved for home screen shortcuts. ## Multitasking Improvements * Added **“Skip app terminate screen”** (by @boa-z) * Added **”Single Window Mode”** to minimize other apps when a maximized app is brought to front * Launch URL schemes can now be passed to multitasking apps. Passing URL between multitask apps can be controlled via **”Redirect URL to Host”** switch * Launching Private Apps is now possible. By default, apps launched with private container is only given sandbox access to its own data container folder. You can change it in developer settings. * Changed animations a little bit ## AltStore Source Support Basic AltSource support has been implemented by @StephenDev0. Sources can be added using: ``` livecontainer://sources?url=<URL> ``` ## Other Additions * App remarks are now supported (by @WingCH) * Decrypted apps can now be installed via `itms-services` links (by @WingCH) # Bug Fixes * Fixed iOS 26.4b1 compatibility (#1152) * Fixed crashes caused by `-[NSUserDefaults synchronize]` returning NO * Fixed signing crashes when apps contain too many libraries (#1135) * Fixed signing failure when not enough space is available to insert HM_DYLIB in Mach-O headers

These windows can be resized, scaled, and even displayed using the native Picture-in-Picture (PiP) feature. On iPads, apps can run in native window mode, displaying each app in a separate system window. And if you wish, you can choose to run apps in multitasking mode by default in settings. Thanks to PR #537 by @SoY0ung, LiveContainer uses the app group included in your `.mobileprovision` file, rather than hard-coded SideStore/AltStore app groups. This unlocks multitasking and other features. >[!Note] >1. Only **development certificates** are supported. >2. To use multitasking, your `.mobileprovision` must contain at least one app group. >3. To enable keychain separation, LiveContainer must be signed with all 128 required keychain access groups. >4. Note: HealthKit entitlements are still required to access health data. - Alleviate #423 by avoiding dyld library validation bypass on signed apps, which otherwise prevents apps that requires JIT from executing JIT pages on A15+ - Fixed #478 by moving the JIT enabling window to `LCAppListView`. - Fixed #476 by updating ZSign. - Fixed #497 by resolving an issue in dyld library validation bypass. - Fixed iOS 16.2 (#495) and iOS 18.4+ on iPad 7 (#531). - Fixed #518 by sending KVO notifications when UsedDefaults is changed. - Fixed #582 by invalidating duplicate library load commands. # Deprecated Features ## SideStore/AltStore Patching With SideStore 0.6.2-20250420.25 and AltStore 2.2.1 both supporting certificate export, patching these stores is no longer necessary. # ⚠️This version ⚠️REQUIRES⚠️ SideStore 0.6.0+ / AltStore 2.0+ to install. This version improved app re-signing experience, add support for new JIT enablers, increased compatibility with relatively old apps and add translation for Arabic, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese and Swedish. >[!Note] LiveContainer has upgraded SDK version to 18.2, which breaks some apps that works on previous versions. Fortunately we have developed the "Spoof SDK Version" feature, forcing system libraries to operate in the SDK version the app is built with. You can enable "Spoof SDK Version". # New Features ## 1. New Re-Sign Strategy Instead of keeping track of expiration date, LiveContainer now directly ask iOS to determine whether the code signature is valid, which significantly decreases app re-sign rate. For now your apps will be re-signed only if their code signature is invalid, which probably happens when your certificate is expired (usually takes a year), or is revoked (when you reinstall SideStore/AltStore). ## 2. Support for StikJIT(StikDebug), SideStore JIT [StikJIT(StikDebug)](https://github.com/StephenDev0/StikJIT) is the newest on-device JIT enabler powered by [idevice](https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice). You can now install it both as a standalone app or install it inside LiveContainer. See #265 item 5.8 for more information. SideStore has recently switched its backend to idevice and added on-device JIT support. For now its JIT URL Scheme has not been implemented so you have to manually enable JIT for LiveContainer. ## 3. Spoof SDK version Spoofing SDK version forces system libraries to operate in the SDK version the app is built with. This fix works surprisingly well so we decided to enable it by default for newly installed apps. This fixes some old apps crashing because of the new SDK. We also removed the "Bypass AssertBarrierOnQueue" fix since the root cause is SDK version. Fix #421 #422 ## 4. Support Import Certificate From SideStore With [this SideStore pr](https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/959), we can now directly retrieve certificate from SideStore (0.6.2-20250420.25+) without the patch, thus simplifying the process of enabling JIT-Less mode. ## 5. Game Mode Support With the SDK version upgrade, LiveContainer now supports game mode. If you don't need it, you can turn it off in the control center. # Bug Fixes 1. Fix a regression caused by NSBundle path fix. Fix #409 2. Keep app's plugin folder in case some apps need files inside. Fix hugeBlack/LiveContainer#43 3. Add TPRO rw in overwrite exec path in case the executable path is TPRO protected. Fix #327 4. Replace all `withCheckedContinuation` with `withUnsafeContinuation` to solve crash on iOS 18.0 beta. Fix #435 5. Add file permission to solve some sign issues. Fix #448 # Removed Features The following features are removed because it's not useful in current version or constantly causing issues. 1. AltSign: We drop AltSign support because it's constantly causing issues and it's relatively old. 2. Bypass AssertBarrierOnQueue: It is replaced by "Spoof SDK version" 3. Sign Only on Signature Expires: It's now useless as we directly determine if an app's code signature is valid by asking the system. # Translation LiveContainer is now translated into Arabic, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese and Swedish - Arabic: translated by dlshad2 - French: translated by @p-sage - German: translated by @BeityBytes - Japanese: translated by @naolad - Portuguese: translated by damn_the_daniel - Swedish: translated by @se2crid # Credit Shout out to @khanhduytran0 for doing a lot of research under the hood! # Other LiveContainer is now migrated from a Theos project to a Xcode project, which simplifies the development and significantly decreased Github Actions build time (2 minutes now and around 10 minutes previously)

## 主要变化 本版改进异常会话恢复和停止处理，并新增可选的后台定位指示器设置。 - **异常中断后可恢复**：坐标写入失败或停止未获设备确认时，保留上次位置与路线进度，无需重启 App 即可选择继续模拟或恢复真实位置。 - **停止等待有了限时**：坐标写入和位置清除增加超时处理，避免设备无响应时一直停留在“正在停止”。未确认清除成功时，仍会保留恢复入口。 - **改善后台保持处理**：定位服务遇到暂时错误时保留更新请求；返回前台后重新检查权限和后台保持状态，首页提示后台保持不可用的情况。 - **新增“减少后台定位指示器”**：默认关闭，主动开启后需要“始终”定位权限。未获得该权限时保持原有显示行为；关闭开关不会撤回已授予的权限，可在系统设置中修改。 - **补充隧道跳转说明**：列表用于选择自动打开的应用，不限制兼容软件。其他代理或 VPN 软件只要正确配置兼容设备隧道，也可手动开启后使用。 ## 下载与安装 - 标准版：`WrapPin-Standard-1.0.18-build61-unsigned.ipa`，供 SideStore 或其他自签方式使用。 - 隧道版：`WrapPin-Tunnel-1.0.18-build61-unsigned.ipa`，需要带 Packet Tunnel 权限的签名证书及描述文件。 - 两个版本均为未签名 IPA，最低系统为 iOS 27.0。免费 Apple 账号和 SideStore 请使用标准版。 SHA-256： - 标准版：`a897774a0dee14f8c2c7a24a9c97eaa041d281c441f116d1613f5164d92aaa57` - 隧道版：`62e66c1036d1046532e30ed1d3e604f06403d8f01afa85988ad40e1d5d037ff2` ## 验证与边界 - 维护者已用 Build 60 在真机上验证主要功能，未逐项记录测试清单。Build 61 的功能代码相同，本身尚未独立装机。 - 两个 scheme 的 Debug、Release 构建，8 个检查脚本及 Rust 10 项单元测试均通过。 - 这次提供异常中断后的手动恢复，不会自动重连，也不保证所有后台连接都能持续。 - 坐标写入和清除分别有 15 秒限时；写入接近限时才完成、随后清除又超时时，停止可能接近 30 秒。限时以 App 能够正常执行为前提。 - 指示器的最终显示由 iOS 决定，系统可能定期提醒后台定位使用。后台保持收到的坐标仍不保存、不上传。 - 从多任务界面划掉 App 会结束模拟连接；VPN 仍显示已连接，不代表模拟仍在生效。 - 原有蜂窝网络限制不变：通过 Shadowrocket、Surge、Loon 建立设备连接仍不可靠，建议使用 Wi-Fi。

apps.localizedDescription: OldOS is a testament to the days of yesteryear, showcasing what iOS once was ten years ago. The ethos of the app is to merge the technologies of today with a pixel-perfect recreation of the user experience of the past. The vast majority of apps in OldOS are fully functional — meaning they seamlessly integrate with the data on your phone to deliver a live, emulator-esque experience. What does this mean? Well, you can play your music in iPod, get directions in Maps, surf the web in Safari, view the current weather in Weather, and much more. By the same token, no shortcuts were taken in fully fleshing out the operating system. You can change your background, adjust settings, search apps, et cetera. There are a few apps still not ready for primetime but don't worry, they're coming soon. With OldOS, you no longer need to worry about securing a legacy iPhone to experience nostalgia — it's available on your daily driver. Part of the goal with OldOS is to enable anyone to understand how iOS works and demonstrate just how powerful SwiftUI truly is. The ethos of the app is to merge the technologies of today with a pixel-perfect recreation of the user experience of the past. Built on scrcpy **v4.0** (SDL3 + FFmpeg 8.1.1). ### Fixes **Mirrored picture geometry** - Fix the picture overflowing the window and not being draggable back. The porting layer applied `SDL_SetRenderScale(nativeScale)` on top of the density conversion scrcpy v4 already performs, magnifying the geometry by density × nativeScale (4× on @2x, 9× on @3x). - Fix the picture being offset to one side from the moment a session connects. The Stage Manager resize path compared the view size in pixels against `SDL_GetWindowSize()`, which SDL3 reports in points, so the sizes never matched and every layout pass pushed a resize event carrying a pixel-sized geometry. **Black screen on high-contrast scene changes** - A full display-layer queue is normal back-pressure; it no longer escalates to flushing the queue and restarting the server-side encoder after 5 dropped frames. Recovery now requires a sustained stall, and the reset cooldown was raised so a second reset cannot land before the previous restart has produced a keyframe. **Disk filling with logs** - The active log file is now bounded at runtime (previously only older files were cleaned, and only at cold start — one user reported a single 76 GB log). - Decoder and render error logs are rate-limited; they previously wrote one line per packet or per frame for as long as the error persisted. **Crashes and background behaviour** - Fix `SIGTRAP`/`SIGABRT` during teardown (`sc_server_destroy`, `sc_main_thread_destroy`, `sc_screen_destroy`/`sc_fps_counter_destroy`) when a session is re-entered in the same process. - Fix the background timeout ignoring the configured duration, and a background-task handle leak that could disconnect an already-disconnected session. - Fix a VNC connect crash and a blank screen after ADB disconnect. ### Install The attached IPA is **Ad Hoc signed** and installs only on devices registered to the developer account. For general use, install via TestFlight or the App Store.

# ByeTunes v2.6 – Favorites, Playlist Pinning & Background Downloads Reworked Hi guys, here is the 2.6 update for ByeTunes. A good amount of things got added, fixed and improved in this one. You can now properly favorite injected songs, pin playlists from inside ByeTunes, and keep downloads going in the background with a new Picture in Picture window. There were also a bunch of fixes around metadata, library management and database safety. **Favorites** There are three new options inside Library Repair: - **Create Favorites Playlist** creates the Favorites playlist using the right name for your device region. - **Fix Missing Favorites** repairs songs injected with an older version that you already favorited but that never actually appeared in Favorites. - **Delete Favorites Playlist** lets you delete that playlist from Library Repair. Songs injected from 2.6 onwards now get their store IDs during injection, so you can favorite them right away. If the metadata fetcher finds a match, ByeTunes uses the IDs from that match. Songs without a match get generated IDs instead. **Quick recommendation:** if you have older injected songs that you favorited but cannot find in Favorites, run **Fix Missing Favorites** inside Library Repair. **Playlist Pinning** You can now pin and unpin playlists from the On-Device Library. Long-press a playlist or use the Pin button from inside it. **Keep in mind: pinning and unpinning these playlists needs to be done through ByeTunes. The Pin option inside the Apple Music app does not work for them.** **Background Downloads** Background downloads got a big rework. ByeTunes now uses silent audio to keep downloads going in the background, with an optional Picture in Picture window so you can see what is happening after leaving the app. The window shows the current song's progress, what is next in the queue, and when metadata is being fetched. You can also customize it with themes, your own colors or a background picture. There is a live preview in Settings so you can see how it looks before using it. This replaces the old background download behavior and Live Activity support. Download progress now shows in the Picture in Picture window. If the app closes while songs are still downloading, those songs go back to the front of the queue the next time you open ByeTunes. Pause and Cancel were fixed too. They now properly stop background transfers instead of accidentally starting a fallback download after you already paused or cancelled the song. **Download Queue & Saving Files** Downloaded songs now get their metadata as part of the download process. You will see a "fetching metadata" state before the song is marked as done, instead of that work being left to a separate background metadata manager. A few other things got added or improved: - **Clear All** for completed items in the queue sheet. - Preview buttons in the album sheet and artist profile. - Icons instead of text in the download queue indicator. - Downloads are now limited to **2 at a time for MP3 and 1 for FLAC**, matching what the server supports. (This is temporal until I can pay for a better provider) - A **server status banner** appears when the server goes into maintenance. Downloads are blocked while the server is down. - A new **Save With Fetched Metadata** toggle that writes the fetched tags and cover artwork into the MP3 and FLAC copies you save. **Metadata Fixes** Metadata matching got a lot of attention in this update. There were cases where a remix could get the original song's information, or a song could get renamed to a different track from the same album. Those issues should now be fixed. - Downloaded songs now look up the exact Deezer track and album. An Apple Music match is only accepted if it belongs to the same album. - Apple Music track matching now checks the title, so songs should no longer get relabeled as another track from that album. - Apple Music search pages are requested in English so ByeTunes can find the Songs and Albu

versions.localizedDescription: BlueWake 0.8.0 brings the Wind Waker HD look, HD textures you make from your own Wind Waker HD game inside the app, more speed by default on Windows and Linux, the same menus on every computer, and an experimental Android build. Every version needs your own USA (GZLE01) disc image. The ready-made Windows build includes the game code translated from my disc; nothing else from the game is included. ### Install **Windows:** download `BlueWake-v0.8.0-windows-x64.zip`, unpack the whole folder and run `BlueWake.exe`. Your saves and settings in `%APPDATA%\BlueWake` carry over. You need Windows 10 or 11 and a CPU with AVX2. A Direct3D 12 GPU is best. On older GPUs BlueWake now tries Direct3D 11 instead of showing a black screen; I haven't been able to check that on such a PC yet, so tell me how it goes. **Linux:** build it from this release's source with `python3 scripts/linux/build.py /path/to/GZLE01.iso` (steps in `docs/LINUX.md`). A ready-made AppImage will be added to this release once one is built and checked. **iPhone and iPad:** build your app with [PadMint](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/padmint/releases/latest) on an Apple Silicon Mac. It downloads `BlueWake-v0.8.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (the app without game code) and adds the game made from your disc. Install it over your current BlueWake to keep your saves. **Mac:** build it from this release's source: `scripts/builder/build.sh "/path/to/GZLE01.iso" --platform macos --out build/macos`. Your saves in `~/Library/Application Support/BlueWake` are kept. **Android (experimental):** build it yourself from your own disc on a Windows PC, as `docs/ANDROID.md` describes (thanks to LiquidAzir). It's checked on one phone so far. ### What's new **The Wind Waker HD look**, off by default - Islands on the horizon from further away, bloom, the far-distance blur, ambient occlusion, cloud shadows, and edge and torch light, kept gentle so the game keeps its colours. Press **F2** on Windows, Mac and Linux, or turn it on under **Mods** on iPhone and iPad. Each piece can be turned off by itself (`docs/WWHD_LOOK.md`). **HD textures from your own Wind Waker HD game** - **Mods › Wind Waker HD textures › Import from Wind Waker HD…** makes the texture pack, HD menus and HUD included, from your decrypted HD dump or a USA WUD/WUX image with its keys, on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and iPad. No Python, and nothing from the Wii U game is included in BlueWake. **Faster** - Behaviour timing is on by default on Windows and Linux: 7 to 11% faster on Intel desktops and 9% on the Steam Deck. - Lighter checks around the game code (thanks to pdale-boop) and Elliott Tate's faster returns and calls. - On Wayland the game runs at full speed (thanks to jslay88). **The same menus and keys on every computer** (thanks to pdale-boop) - F1 settings, F2 the HD look, F5 and F8 save and load state, F7 the stage select, F9 the frame rate, F10 Smooth Motion, F11 fullscreen. The Windows menu works with a controller, and Linux gets Restart now and safe mode. **Controls** - The D-pad moves the cursor in Items and Quest Status, gyro aiming with a DualSense, DualShock 4, Switch Pro or Steam Deck, swapping L and R, and 21:9 widescreen. **Fixes** - Lenzo accepts the right Picto Box photos (thanks to jslay88). - Each island's sea chart shows its own map. - The Greatfish merchant stays on his raft (thanks to jslay88). - Resizing the window on Linux no longer crashes (thanks to pdale-boop). **Also new** - The developers' stage select, off by default, with 468 places to jump to from your own file (thanks to pdale-boop). - Linux: portable mode, a working texture-pack folder picker (thanks to jkoehler11), and the build container (thanks to cforain). ### How it was checked I built the Windows version on my PC (Ryzen 7 5700U) from my own disc, from the same commit, in 81 minutes. It starts, draws with Direct3D 12 and quits cleanly; I only tried it briefly at Outset this time. I built the iPhone and iPad app without game code from this releas

BlueWake 0.7.0 is faster, especially on older and smaller CPUs, and fixes several controller problems. Every version needs your own USA (GZLE01) disc image. The ready-made Windows build includes the game code translated from my disc; nothing else from the game is included. ### Install **Windows:** download `BlueWake-v0.7.0-windows-x64.zip`, unpack the whole folder and run `BlueWake.exe`. Your saves and settings in `%APPDATA%\BlueWake` carry over. You need Windows 10 or 11, a Direct3D 12 GPU, and a CPU with AVX2. **iPhone and iPad:** build your app with [PadMint](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/padmint/releases/latest) on an Apple Silicon Mac. It downloads `BlueWake-v0.7.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (the app without game code) and adds the game made from your disc. Install it over your current BlueWake to keep your saves. **Linux:** build it from this release's source with `python3 scripts/linux/build.py /path/to/GZLE01.iso` (steps in `docs/LINUX.md`). A ready-made AppImage, with a setup window that asks for your disc the first time, is coming to this release shortly. **Mac:** build it from this release's source: `scripts/builder/build.sh "/path/to/GZLE01.iso" --platform macos --out build/macos`. Your saves in `~/Library/Application Support/BlueWake` are kept. ### What's new **Faster** - Elliott Tate's lean block copies are now how BlueWake builds the game: 5 to 12% faster, most on slower CPUs (measured by pdale-boop). - Windows: Elliott's draw fusion sends the graphics card about a tenth as many draws, so busy places like Forest Haven, Hyrule and boss fights no longer wait on graphics. On slower CPUs he measured 30 to 60% more frames there. - Faster single-precision float loads in the game code, also from Elliott. - Linux: the game compiles about twice as fast when you build it, and runs up to 10% faster on slower CPUs (pdale-boop). - Building your own copy is faster everywhere: the optimization training takes about 12 minutes instead of 30 (pdale-boop), and a second build into the same folder works again. **Smoother** - With Smooth Motion on, CPUs with 8 threads or more no longer drop to 30 for seconds after a hitch. **Controllers** - A controller that's already plugged in when BlueWake starts now gets the smooth stick and plays as player 1 (#138). - With a GameCube adapter, press a button on your controller and it becomes player 1, even if it isn't in port 1 (#155). - Rumble only shakes the controller you're playing with (#190). - The left stick works at the Pictobox's "keep this picture?" and in the gallery (#191). - New, optional: hold the right-stick click and move it up or down to zoom the camera, under Controls (thanks to cforain). **Fixes and more** - A rare crash that could stop the game anywhere (`unmapped pc=0x8180fff0`), tracked down by pdale-boop. - Windows: the window opens where you left it (thanks to saulob), and portable mode keeps your remaps and window layout in its own folder (#64). - You can place the FPS counter in a corner, under Display (thanks to saulob). - The session log names the graphics API in use, and Linux says when it fell back to a much slower renderer because Vulkan is missing. ### How it was checked The Windows build was made on my PC (Ryzen 7 5700U) from my own disc, and it starts, runs and quits cleanly there. Every change passed the Windows and Linux builds and tests. The speed changes were measured before they went in: lean blocks by pdale-boop on Windows and Linux, including a 15-minute play session, and draw fusion by Elliott, who checked that the game plays the same. I built and checked the iPhone and iPad app without game code, the source and the PadMint recipe on a Mac. I haven't yet played this build with a controller on every platform, so if something doesn't work on your setup, please tell me. ### Known problems - Draw fusion is on for Windows only for now. On Linux and Mac you can try it with `DOL_GX_FUSE=1`; tell me how it looks. - Busy scenes can still run below 30 FPS on slower CPUs

[Details](https://github.com/kolbicz/Cyanide#supported-devices) # Cyanide 1.15.0 The iPad Dock, with its App Library button, on iPhone. ## New - **iPad Dock** (Installer → SpringBoard): turns the Dock into SpringBoard's own iPad-style Dock, including the App Library button, for the current SpringBoard session. Writes no system files; turning it off brings the stock Dock back, and so does a respring. - The App Library button opens its own App Library, so the App Library page stays as it is. - Works together with **Disable App Library**: the App Library is then only in the Dock. - Ported from [hxhlb/cyanide](https://github.com/hxhlb/cyanide) (by Banana), with fixes for iOS 18 and for the App Library page breaking after the Dock's App Library was opened. ## About A18 / M4 On A18 / M4 devices a run has about a 50/50 chance of rebooting the device (a kernel "panic") instead of succeeding — a known limit of these chips that can't be fully fixed. It's a coin flip, so if it reboots, just try again; a few attempts usually gets there. Once a run works, it stays working until your next restart. If you keep hitting panics, Settings → Launch Options has four knobs for the A18 chain — exploit path (pe_v3 default, pe_v1 / pe_v2), memory shaping, interleaved search and bounded search. Defaults are unchanged in this release; other combinations may do better on your device. Each applies to the next fresh run.

> **Supported:** iPhone / iPad on iOS/iPadOS `17.0 – 18.7.1` or `26.0 – 26.0.1`. > **Not supported:** iPhone 17 (A19 / A19 Pro) and M5 — Memory Integrity Enforcement. > Any other device on a supported version works. [Details](https://github.com/kolbicz/Cyanide#supported-devices) # Cyanide 1.14.0 Font Overwrite, including the Lock Screen clock, and SpringBoard Tools that apply together with your other tweaks. ## New - **Font Overwrite** (Settings → Lara): replace the system font, its italic and monospaced variants, or the **Lock Screen clock** with a font of your own. Thanks to [@rooootdev](https://github.com/rooootdev), whose lara this idea comes from. - The font is replaced in memory only. Nothing on the sealed system volume changes, and a restart always brings the original back. **Restore** does it without a restart (the original is backed up first). - Import a `.ttf`, `.otf` or `.ttc` from Files, tap it and pick what to replace. It has to be the same size as the system's font or smaller. - A plain font is adapted on the device so iOS accepts it as the system font (its weights and names, like lara's font patcher). Fonts with PostScript (CFF) outlines can't be adapted. - **Lock Screen Clock** changes every clock style at once. The weight slider has no effect on the new font. - The Lock Screen and its widgets are refreshed automatically. Respring to see the change everywhere else. ## Changes - **SpringBoard Tools:** new **Apply with Tweaks** switch. v1.2 makes games load faster, fixes crashes on game start, lets you remap your controller and reworks the on-screen controls. ## Highlights - **Faster loading:** compiled shaders are kept between launches, so a game starts much quicker the second time. - **Fewer crashes:** game start no longer crashes when memory is tight or when JIT takes a moment to connect. - **Controller remapping:** Settings › Controls › Controller buttons. Pick a GamePad button, press the one on your controller that should drive it. Touch controls keep their layout. - **All touch options in the game:** open HOME › Move controls for size, opacity, stick spacing, shoulder height, haptics, deadzone and hiding the controls when a controller is connected. ## Performance - Faster Metal renderer with fewer per-draw costs. - The shader cache is saved as soon as you leave the app. - New settings: Favour accuracy, Favour performance and One-core mode, globally and per game. ## Stability and JIT - If JIT cannot start, the game runs with the slower interpreter instead of crashing. - The recompiler survives low memory. - Quitting a game no longer freezes the app. - LocalDevVPN is checked live: JIT turns grey when the VPN is off and comes back by itself. - Built-in pairing needs iOS 27. On older versions you can import a pairing file. ## Controls - The on-screen controls hide at once when a controller connects (if you turn that on), and come back when it disconnects. - Sticks are always round. - New HOME symbol, and a blow button next to the FPS display for games that ask you to blow into the mic. - The in-game buttons fade out after a few seconds (on by default on iPhone, off on iPad). Tap or swipe down at the top edge to bring them back. - The iPhone game list and settings work with a controller. ## Game page and menus - New game page with collapsible groups. Save export/import and shader cache import are there, and graphic packs have their own page. - New Add menu that works with a controller. - Graphic pack downloads no longer get stuck at 100%. - Open-source licences now list MuffinEMU, which EspressU is based on. ## Install 1. Download the unsigned `EspressU-1.2.ipa` below. 2. Install it with SideInstaller (or SideStore/AltStore) and turn on the increased memory limit. Without it, most games run out of memory. 3. For JIT, import your pairing file in Settings › JIT and connect LocalDevVPN. Updating from v1.1 keeps your games, saves and settings. EspressU contains no firmware, keys or games. Use your own dumps from your own Wii U.

# EspressU v1.1 A big update for iPhone, plus second-screen support and fixes. ## iPhone - New game library: two-column grid with a "Continue playing" card for your last game. Long-press a game for favourite and options. - Pull down to search. The keyboard opens right away; Cancel or a tap elsewhere closes it. - The in-game top bar hides itself. Swipe down from the top edge to bring it back. - Settings are a compact list that fits a phone screen. - iPad keeps its current layout. ## Second screen - External display support is on by default. The TV screen goes to the external display and your device works as the Wii U GamePad. - Pause and the FPS counter stay on your device. - On older iOS versions, AirPlay may still only mirror your screen. ## Fixes and improvements - Graphic pack options no longer close the game settings menu. - Vulkan: fewer GPU errors on Apple GPUs and no memory spikes when scenes load. - Fixed a crash when starting a game without JIT. - Zone is now the default control style for new players. - Better logging when the built-in JIT check fails. - GitHub links updated, Discord link added (Settings > About). Based on MuffinEMU by Void ## What's Changed * Vulkan on iOS: fix GPU page faults and a memory spike (from MuffinEMU 10.1 and 10.2) by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/2 * About screen: credit MuffinEMU in the app by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/4 * Make Zone the default control style for new players by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/5 * Fix the crash when launching a game without JIT (SIGTRAP in BreakGetJITMapping) by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/6 * Log the reason when the built-in JIT preflight fails by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/7 * Improve iPhone UI, add AirPlay GamePad mode, fix graphic pack settings by @EspressU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/8 ## New Contributors * @MuffinEMU made their first contribution in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/2 * @EspressU made their first contribution in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/8 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/compare/v1.0...v1.1

NBA Showtime (PlayStation USA) joins the four existing ports. All five iOS apps and Windows executables are version 0.3.0. Changes: - SSF2T: fixed 512-column widescreen output prevents camera-dependent resizing. Unsupported stage edges are clipped inside the fixed canvas and filled with colored margins; scenery is not mirrored. - Slam 'n Jam '96: extend the SLES-00076 game's crowd/court clipping checks, rather than only widening the GPU canvas. Original interior pixels and HUD are preserved. No coin prompts; Restart Game remains the console action. - UMK3: extend solid background/gradient clears into the extra columns before drawing foreground scenery, fixing the rectangular gap reproduced in Scorpion's Lair. - THPS2: keep the gameplay HUD in the centered original 4:3 area. Increase the normal follow-camera offset by 25% through a guarded boot-time instruction patch, verified on the USA executable. Black letterbox bars and CRT toggle are retained. - NBA Showtime: supplied PlayStation USA BIN support, four-player multitap, Hangtime-style controls/UI, centered HUD and expanded gameplay canvas, CRT enabled by default with on/off controls. - Include THPS2's Windows C++ runtime DLLs and version all five builds consistently. Downloads: - NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip: all five Windows games. Extract it and keep every DLL beside its EXE. - Five unsigned IPAs: sign with your sideloading tool. Keep existing bundle identifiers to preserve app data. - SHA256SUMS.txt: checksums for the downloadable builds. Game files and signing credentials are not included. NBA Showtime needs the extracted raw PlayStation MODE2/2352 BIN named nbashowt.bin, not its archive or an arcade ROM. Validation: all ten platform builds passed; Apple/SDL virtual-controller tests, shader compilation, texture-cache checks, rendering helper regressions and local gameplay captures passed. Local captures covered SSF2T camera limits, Slam court pans, UMK3 Scorpion's Lair, THPS2 Hangar, and NBA Showtime gameplay/toggle/HUD. This is not complete stage coverage or physical iPhone/Windows multiplayer validation. THPS2 iOS still uses the CPU interpreter; this release does not claim a verified frame-rate improvement. Some Slam camera angles can still reveal the finite arena's dark exterior.

SSF2T and Slam n Jam 0.2.2 iOS and Windows builds passed. iOS IPAs are unsigned; sign/install with ESign, keeping the existing bundle identifiers. Slam n Jam: startup asks for keyboard 1 or controller Start, with no coin prompt. Restart reads RESTART GAME. PS1 Select is available as Select (keyboard Tab, controller View); old settings migrate. Native gameplay canvas expands from 320 to 426 columns instead of stretching. Original-size sprites, text and HUD remain centered; textures live in original VRAM and expanded framebuffers use separate banks. CRT behavior is unchanged. SSF2T: reflected edge artwork removed. The visible gameplay window narrows symmetrically as the camera approaches finite stage boundaries, returning to the original 384 columns at either limit. It expands away from those limits. Menus keep their original proportions centered in a 512-column frame with colored sides. Validation: iOS and Windows builds, controller suite, canvas isolation and stage-boundary tests passed. Real Slam gameplay toggled 320 -> 426 -> 320 columns; all 81,920 pixels of the central original view matched the same saved frame exactly. Real SSF2T gameplay captures returned to 384 columns at both edges, and menu captures were 512 columns with colored margins. Device-specific iPhone and Windows gameplay still needs retesting. No game files or game screenshots are included. SSF2T and Slam n Jam are version 0.2.2. The unchanged THPS2 and UMK3 version 0.2.1 builds are also included here. Download NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip for all four current Windows builds; the smaller SSF2T-SlamJam96 ZIP contains only those two games. BUILD-VERSIONS.txt inside the complete ZIP identifies every game version.

THPS2 now has a direct CRT ON/OFF button during iPhone gameplay, black top/bottom letterbox bars on iOS and Windows, and a renderer adjustment to keep flat HUD overlays in the central 4:3 area. The iOS CPU interpreter also has a faster RAM instruction-fetch path. Slam ’n Jam widescreen projection now runs before guest clipping and preserves native sprite/text rendering. SSF2T extends finite scenery edges with mirrored backgrounds while preserving sprite priority. UMK3 extends mixed background tile bands with safeguards for unrelated props. ### Downloads - Four unsigned iOS IPAs: sign and install using ESign. - Windows x64 ZIP: contains all four games and required SDL libraries. - SHA256SUMS.txt: checksums for the downloadable builds. Existing bundle identifiers are preserved. Game files are not included. NBA Showtime remains unfinished and is not included. ### Validation and remaining checks All four iOS and Windows builds passed. Controller, VRAM, GTE projection and stage-edge regression checks passed; 92 Dreamcast shader variants compiled and linked. A local Slam ’n Jam gameplay capture showed complete crowd rendering in one tested camera. THPS2 iPhone frame-rate improvement and HUD placement still need device confirmation. Slam ’n Jam shot-clock readability and other cameras, plus affected SSF2T and UMK3 stages, still need gameplay retesting. Native PS1 resolution is unchanged. SSF2T edge scenery uses reflected existing artwork.

NativePorts 0.2.0 includes Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3, Slam ’n Jam ’96 and Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 2 for iOS and Windows. - Uses the supplied game artwork for each iOS app and Windows executable/window icon. Keeps unique bundle IDs unchanged to preserve installed game data. - Adds game-specific widescreen patches for SSF2T, UMK3 and Slam ’n Jam ’96, alongside the existing Flycast widescreen patch for THPS2. Widescreen can be toggled in display settings. - Updates aspect-ratio handling and NewPixie CRT rendering to preserve picture edges. CRT filtering remains enabled by default and can be disabled. - Refreshes cached core sources before builds so source changes rebuild the embedded engine. - Includes touch controls and remappable multiplayer controller support on both platforms. Download one unsigned IPA per game and sign it with your sideloading tool. For Windows, extract NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip and keep each EXE beside its SDL2.dll. Use your own game files; ROMs, disc images and signing credentials are not included. Known limitations: THPS2 on iOS uses an interpreter and may run below full speed. Slam ’n Jam ’96 can leave dark corners in some widescreen camera angles. NBA Showtime remains frontend-only and is not included. Validation: all four iOS build logs report success; Windows binaries were packaged from the latest local builds. Virtual controller tests passed for all five frontends, along with ROM-import checks, basketball action tests and both THPS2 texture-cache configurations. These checks do not establish full-speed performance or physical multiplayer operation on every device. SHA256SUMS.txt contains asset checksums.

Android and iOS mobile builds of Mega Man 64: Recompiled. - Editable gameplay and menu touch pads: movement stick, N64 buttons, position/size/opacity/color controls, and GAME PAD / MENU PAD switching. - SDL USB/Bluetooth controller support and configurable bindings. - Mobile renderer fixes, Android Vulkan surface/descriptor handling, and iOS screenshot/notification size restoration. - Persistent USA FlashRAM saves, atomic replacement, backup writes, and background save flushing. - The supplied Mega Man 64 artwork is now the app icon on both platforms. - Both application IDs are `com.devz.megaman64`, matching the other ports' naming convention. **Downloads:** install the ARM64 APK on Android 8.0+ with a compatible Vulkan GPU. Sign the ARM64 IPA for your own iOS 16+ device using eSign or another signing tool. The IPA contains no personal certificate or provisioning profile. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers both downloads. **ROM:** supply your own Mega Man 64 USA ROM through the launcher. `.z64`, `.v64`, and `.n64` byte orders are accepted. Japanese Rockman DASH gameplay is not supported by this USA recompilation; the loader reports that limitation. No ROM or save data is bundled. **Existing saves:** the new IDs create separate app storage. Back up the old app's `config/saves` folder before changing builds, preserve filenames, and keep the old app installed until the backup is safe. Storage locations and restoration limits are described in MOBILE.md. Saves are not automatically migrated between different IDs. The repository starts with a clean source history and pinned dependencies. It excludes ROM-derived generated sources, ROMs, saves, logs, SDKs, local build folders, personal paths, and signing keys. Required build scripts, application assets, licenses, and upstream attribution remain available. Validation: source privacy and whitespace checks; dependency patches applied against pinned revisions; APK signature and 16 KB alignment; ARM64 package structure; ROM/private-path scans; icon pixel checks, application IDs, Android Java class and all renamed JNI entry points. Rendering/gameplay had been confirmed on iOS and Adreno 710 Android before these icon/ID/publication changes. Installation of this newly packaged release still needs verification on devices. Upstream: https://github.com/MegaMan64Recomp/MegaMan64Recompiled

### New - **Mouse sensitivity (Controls → Edit touch layout).** A Sensitivity slider sets how fast the on-screen cursor moves when you drag in PAD mode. - **Saved touch layouts.** The touch editor has a **Saved** menu: save the current layout under a name, load one, replace it with the current layout, or delete it. - **Aim stick attack.** Choose what the aim stick does: **Off**, **Release** (one attack in the aimed direction when you let go) or **Auto** (attacks over and over while the stick is pushed, using whatever you have equipped). - **Two-finger zoom switch (Settings → Controls).** Turns the two-finger scroll that zooms the game on or off. - **ZombieBuddy switch (Developer Tools → Tools).** Starts the game with `-javaagent:ZombieBuddy.jar` for mods that need ZombieBuddy. Put `ZombieBuddy.jar` in the game folder (Files, pziOS, game); if the file is missing the switch is skipped. - **Zink graphics backend (experimental, Developer Tools → Tools).** An optional second graphics path: **Graphics Backend: Zink (Experimental)** runs the game on Mesa's Zink (OpenGL 4.5 on Vulkan) over MoltenVK (Vulkan on Metal) instead of the normal gl4es + MetalANGLE layer. It exists for mods that need desktop OpenGL 4.5, for example **Viewpoint** (a 3D renderer mod, needs ZombieBuddy), uses more memory, and is off by default. Next to it: **Zink Detailed Log** (writes frame timing, draw and pipeline counts and the graphics limits of your device to `jvm.log` every few seconds) and **Zink Probe** (checks which OpenGL 4.5 features your device supports and saves a short report as `zink-probe.txt` in the pziOS folder). **If you try Zink, please turn on Zink Detailed Log and send your `jvm.log` (and `zink-probe.txt`) together with your device and iOS version; that data is what we need to make it faster.** - **iOS 17 and 18 Support.** On iOS 26 and later pziOS gets its executable memory from the debugger as a mirror-mapped region. On iOS 17 and 18, pziOS now uses the JVM's classic code-cache path instead, chosen automatically and logged as `settings: JIT path classic` in `jvm.log`. Please report results on iOS 17 and 18 with your `jvm.log`. ## Use the included 'pzios-jam.js' in StikDebug to configure manual JIT. ### Join Us In https://discord.gg/7fNEVQpkaA

### New - **Virtual Gamepad (Controls tab).** The on-screen controls can act as a game controller (two sticks, A/B/X/Y, D-pad, bumpers, triggers, Back/Start). - **Increased Memory** Holds the game's Java memory in helper processes, so iOS does not count it against the app's own limit (the app's memory then shows lower; the device's real RAM is still the limit). It uses private iOS features, needs the app's extensions (it does not work inside container apps such as LiveContainer) and may stop working after an iOS update. ### Fixed - **The game crashed at the main menu on a fresh install.** The game's preview videos need a video library pziOS does not ship; pziOS now keeps the game's "video effects" option off. ### Improved - **Clearer JIT helper errors.** If the built-in JIT helper cannot start, the message now says what to check and shows an error number. The first lines of `jvm.log` now show the app's bundle ID, version, JIT method and helper ID, which makes problem reports much easier to read. ### We're Actively Looking For Beta Testers Join Us In https://discord.gg/7fNEVQpkaA

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install ## 改进 - **输入读数不完整时，不再当作输入功率显示。** 在 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，输入传感器只测到了一部分功率（比如实际 43.5 W 只显示 21.8 W）。现在当进入电芯的功率比输入读数还大时，表盘改为显示"进入电池"的功率，不再计算效率和适配器利用率，并在功率页和适配器页说明原因。 - **电池温度改用中位数。** 部分机型有四个同名的电池温度传感器，其中一个明显偏高。"电池"读数、热力图上的电池标记和分区标题现在都用中位数，四个读数仍然逐个列出。 - **异常温度不再参与计算。** 以下读数不再计入热力图和最高温度，但仍保留在"原始数据"里，并注明原因：低于 −10 °C 的 PMU 传感器、高于 85 °C 而结温对不上的充电芯片温度、恰好为 0.0 °C 的传感器。 - **支持 iPad。** 支持横竖屏，内容不再横向拉满。iPad 的传感器对应关系还没有验证，数据仅供参考。 - **文案更准确。** "来自充电器"改为"手机接口处 / 充电线圈处"；适配器页注明额定功率是协商出的上限，不是功率计读数。 - **原始数据更便于反馈。** 每个传感器带上服务编号，并列出被排除的读数。 ## 修复 - 适配器：供电规格列表里不再出现"65.5 V × 65.53 A"这样的无效档位。 - 实时活动：App 在前台时，读数变化 0.05 就会更新，不再等到变化 0.2 W 或 0.5 °C。 ## 注意 - 这些修复是根据用户反馈的数据做的，没有在对应机型的真机上验证过。如果你的机型上读数仍然不对，请在 设置 → 原始数据 里复制导出并反馈。 - iPhone 18 Pro Max 高功率充电时的完整输入功率仍然读不到，需要该机型在 45 W 状态下的原始数据导出。 - App 退到后台后，灵动岛上的读数会停住，这是系统限制；想持续看实时读数请使用悬浮表。 --- ## Improvements - **An incomplete input reading is no longer shown as the input.** On an iPad Pro and an iPhone 18 Pro Max the input sensors see only part of the power (21.8 W shown for a real 43.5 W, for one). When more power is reaching the cell than the input reading accounts for, the dial now shows the "into battery" figure, efficiency and adapter utilisation are not worked out, and the Power and Adapter pages say why. - **Battery temperature is a median.** Some models have four battery temperature sensors under one name, one of them reading clearly high. The Battery readout, the heat map's battery pin and the zone header all use the median now; all four are still listed. - **Impossible temperatures are left out.** These no longer reach the heat map or the hottest reading, and stay in Raw data with a reason: a PMU sensor below −10 °C, a charge-IC temperature above 85 °C that its junction sensor does not back up, and a sensor at exactly 0.0 °C. - **iPad support.** All orientations, and content no longer stretches edge to edge. The sensor mapping on iPad is unverified, so treat its numbers with care. - **More accurate wording.** "From charger" is now "At phone port" / "At charging coil", and the Adapter page says the rating is a negotiated ceiling, not a wall-meter reading. - **Raw data is easier to report from.** Every sensor carries its service index, and excluded readings are listed. ## Fixes - Adapter: the profile list no longer shows an invalid "65.5 V × 65.53 A" entry. - Live Activity: with the app in front, it updates on a 0.05 change instead of waiting for 0.2 W or 0.5 °C. ## Notes - These fixes were made from data users reported and were not verified on those devices. If readings still look wrong on your model, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it. - On an iPhone 18 Pro Max the full input power at high-power charging still cannot be read; a Raw data dump taken at 45 W on that model is needed. - Once the app is in the background the Dynamic Island reading stops. That is a system limit; use the floating meter for a live reading. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install ## 改进 - **缺失的读数不再显示成 0。** 某一侧没有读数时（例如无线充电没有输入电流），图表在那一段断开，不再掉到 0；能量统计也只累计真正测到的时间段。 - **充电效率更准。** "电芯占比"和"负载与损耗"只按输入侧、电池侧同时有读数的时间段计算，某一侧中途缺失不会再把结果带偏。 - **两个标签改名。** "以热量损失"改为"负载与损耗"：这部分是手机自身耗电加上转换损耗，并不全是发热。"效率 / 往返效率"改为"电芯占比"。 - **"暂停充电"的判断更稳。** 状态切换要持续 30 秒才生效，不再来回跳；没有电池电流读数时显示"保持状态未知"，不再直接当成暂停充电。 - **耗电估算不再因为切到后台而清空。** 短暂离开 App 再回来，估算值还在。 - **历史文件损坏时不再被直接覆盖。** 读不出来的历史文件会改名保留，并在"原始数据"页给出提示。 - **发热相关的说明更准确。** 系统热状态只说明"可能"在限制充电电流，不再说成确定的原因。 ## 修复 - 历史记录：没有测到输入侧的记录，"输入"和"充电器峰值"显示为"—"，不再显示 0；列表里的迷你曲线改画电池侧功率，不再空白。 - 实时活动：灵动岛展开后，右上角的状态文字和"结束"按钮不再被圆角裁掉；暂停提示能完整显示。 - 原始数据：重名的 HID 服务各占一行，不再被合并。 ## 注意 - 升级后历史记录的格式有变化，旧版本读不了新格式。**如果从 1.5.0 降级回旧版本，历史记录会丢失。** --- ## Improvements - **A missing reading is no longer shown as 0.** When a rail has no reading (wireless charging has no input current, for one), the charts break there instead of dropping to zero, and energy is only counted over time that was actually measured. - **Charge efficiency is more accurate.** "Cell share" and "Load + loss" are computed only over the time both the input and the battery side were read, so one side dropping out no longer skews them. - **Two labels renamed.** "Lost as heat" is now "Load + loss": it is the phone's own consumption plus conversion loss, not all heat. "Efficiency" / "Round trip" is now "Cell share". - **"Charging on hold" is steadier.** A change has to last 30 seconds before it shows, so it no longer flickers; with no battery-current reading at all it says "hold status unknown" instead of assuming a hold. - **The discharge estimate survives a short trip to the background** instead of being cleared every time. - **An unreadable history file is no longer overwritten.** It is renamed and kept, and Raw data says so. - **Thermal wording is more careful.** The system thermal state says charging *may* be limited; it is no longer stated as the cause. ## Fixes - History: a session whose input side was never measured shows "—" for Delivered and the charger's peak instead of 0, and its row draws the battery curve instead of nothing. - Live Activity: the expanded Dynamic Island no longer clips its status text and End button, and the paused message fits. - Raw data: HID services that share a name are listed as separate rows. ## Note - The history file format changed and older versions cannot read it. **Downgrading from 1.5.0 loses the session history.** **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0

apps.localizedDescription: Apollo is an app for Reddit built for customizability, smoothness, gestures, and taking advantage of everything iOS has to offer. Apollo is a beautiful Reddit app built for fast navigation with an incredibly powerful set of features. Thanks to features like the Jump Bar, fully customizable gestures, and a super-charged Media Viewer, browsing Reddit has never been this amazing. It's created specifically with iOS design guidelines in mind, so it fits right at home on your device, and with input from thousands of Redditors helping sculpt and perfect it over several years before launching: • Jump Bar, for super-fast hopping between subreddits • Super-charged Media Viewer for an amazing experience viewing images, GIFs, videos, albums, and more from a variety of sources. • Tabbed interface for easy navigating • Incredibly powerful Markdown composer for writing comments and posts • Full inline Imgur uploading, both images and albums • Large or compact posts depending on your preference • Dark mode (can be automatic) • Fully customizable gestures • Safari View Controller for browsing articles and links • Inline previews of media in comments • 3D Touch support • Beautifully organized Inbox • Filtering and blocking • Face ID / Touch ID / Passcode lock • Moderator features • Tons of settings to tweak • GIF scrubbing to go backward and forward in time • Multiple accounts • Powerful search • Full Markdown rendering • Unobtrusive Volume Indicator As well as much, much more and it's constantly evolving. If you have anything you'd specifically like to see, come to the ApolloApp subreddit and we'd love to hear it! Apollo is an unofficial app, and side effects may include an incredible browsing experience.
